notablePrerequisites: Arcum Dagsson does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Arcum Dagsson's Ability, sacrificing any other artifact creature.
When the card you search for enters the battlefield, it is an artifact creature due to March of the Machines, and thus triggers Intruder Alarm and Genesis Chamber.
Untap Arcum Dagsson with Intruder Alarm.
Generate a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token with Genesis Chamber.
Repeat the combo from the top by sacrificing the Myr token.
